% Pattern: proof/attach/announce. A [ after \begin{proof} and a blank line is
% the text of the proof, as "[$\Rightarrow$] Suppose", and not its option, so
% the sentence before the proof still names what it proves. Seen in the gold
% pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here labels=main
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 2 status=here labels=aux
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1
% want proof-2 proof - proves=theorem-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}\label{main} A space is bounded if and only if it is compact. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma}\label{aux} Every finite union of balls is bounded. \end{lemma}
\begin{proof} Take the largest radius. \end{proof}

We are now able to prove Theorem \ref{main}.

\begin{proof}

[$\Rightarrow$] Take a finite cover and apply Lemma \ref{aux}.

[$\Leftarrow$] The other way is plain.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
